findings.problem: removedCommandHint answers a typed /provider in the readline AGENT REPL with 'run /connect', but that REPL implements no /connect: READLINE_AGENT_COMMANDS (shell.ts ~272) omits it, and its own comment says /model and /connect are 'TUI pickers ... that have no readline equivalent'. The hint is added to the readline agent unknown-command branch and the registry helper is surface-agnostic.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the hint only where /connect exists: either pass the surface to removedCommandHint (or have the readline agent branch use the plain 'Type /help.' text), or word the hint surface-neutrally ('use the Providers dialog in the TUI, /connect in chat').

findings.quote: Providers picker: switch to a connected provider or add one (picker when available)
findings.problem: The chat-mode registry text says /connect can 'add one', and /provider was removed on the grounds that /connect now covers it. In the readline chat loop /connect is selectAndApply({ onlyConnected: true }) -> realSelectProviderModel (shell.ts ~1363-1391), which ignores onlyConnected and runs pickProviderModel over already detected providers only; there is no add/key/login step. The removed chat branch also carried /provider <name> (a by-name switch that kept model and base URL) and /provider openai-codex (selectAndApply({ onlyProvider: 'openai-codex' })), and neither has a /connect equivalent in this loop. Whether detectProviders still lists openai-codex without the removed entry was not checked here.
findings.suggested_fix: Either reword the chat description to what the readline picker does ('Providers picker: switch among detected providers'), or add the missing arguments to chat /connect (/connect <name>, /connect openai-codex) before dropping /provider. Also fix the stale JSDoc in shell-types.ts, which says /connect 'switch among live providers' while the real selector does not filter on onlyConnected.

findings.quote: logs, or echoes the key. Then run /connect to pick the anthropic provider.
findings.problem: CONNECT_GUIDANCE is what /connect prints when deps.selectProviderModel is undefined (the 'not available' path). The rewrite turns its last sentence from 'run /provider' into 'run /connect', so the guidance printed by /connect tells the user to run /connect.
findings.suggested_fix: End the guidance with a way that works without the picker, e.g. 'Then restart keryx and pick the provider with /connect' or name the CLI route (keryx auth / the env var in the next launch).

findings.quote: function pickProvidersTabbedStep(otui: OpenTui, target: StepTarget, opts: ProvidersTabbedStepOptions): Promise<ProvidersTabAction> {
findings.problem: pickProvidersTabbedStep holds, in one closure of roughly 350 lines, the view (row/button/notice rendering, window scrolling), the tab/selection/nav state machine, the keypress router, and persistence/network effects (disconnectProvider, probeProviderConnection, catalog-cache reads). The step contract says it 'only reports what was chosen', but it also performs Disconnect and Test itself. The Add tab added a second row layout, a second nav state (addAction), per-tab selection/window records and a notice channel on top of the Connected tab's logic.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract the tab/selection/pending-disconnect state and the effects (test, disconnect) into a small controller object with injected effect functions, leaving the step to render and route keys. Not required for this PR.

findings.problem: The rule 'this provider needs a key and has none' is written twice: in runProviderConnectSequence (skip branch, with `requireKey`) as `(connectionProviderByName(prov.name, deps.configDir)?.requiresApiKey ?? true) && classifyProviderConnection(...).kind === "no-credential"`, and in probeProviderConnection as `deps.requireCredential && (provider.requiresApiKey ?? true) && classifyProviderConnection(...).kind === "no-credential"`. The two share a purpose (Add tab [Connect] and [Test] must agree on what counts as 'no credential') but not an implementation.
findings.suggested_fix: Add one helper, e.g. `providerLacksRequiredCredential(name, env, configDir): boolean`, next to classifyProviderConnection and call it from both sites.

findings.problem: `onlyConnected: true` used to mean 'list only connected providers'. It now selects the whole two-tab Providers dialog, whose Add tab lists every detected provider, connected or not, and which can connect new ones. The flag name, `SelectProviderModelOptions.onlyConnected`, `ChatShellOptions.pickSelection({ onlyConnected })` and the chat-shell/agent-shell callers still carry the old meaning; only a comment says otherwise.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename the option to the intent (e.g. `providersDialog: true` / `mode: "manage"`) at the three sites, or document the new meaning on the option's JSDoc where it is declared.

findings.quote:
if (action === undefined) {
      this.ctx.record("/connect not answered in time; nothing changed");
findings.problem: The picker-answer guard `if (x === "refused") return "failed"; if (x === undefined) { record("... not answered in time; nothing changed"); return "failed"; }` is now written five times in this class. The diff adds two new copies in pickAddableProvider (after `this.pick(...)` and after `this.ask(...)`), next to the existing ones in pickModel, pickProvider and pickSession. The string "/connect not answered in time; nothing changed" alone appears three times inside the /connect flow.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract one private helper, e.g. `settledOrFailed(answer, command)`, that returns true when the caller should stop, records the timeout text and handles "refused"; call it at all five sites.

findings.quote:
if (host.listAddableProviders === undefined) {
      await this.ctx.reply("/connect is not available from this shell.").catch(() => false);
findings.problem: This guard in pickAddableProvider cannot be reached. The method is private and has exactly two callers, both in pickProvider (lines 616 and 634), and both run only when `canAdd` (`host.listAddableProviders !== undefined`) is true. The check and its reply are dead code, and the reply text reads as though the path exists.
findings.suggested_fix: Pass the already-checked `listAddableProviders` function (or the host method) into pickAddableProvider as a parameter, or use a non-optional host type there, and delete the guard.

findings.problem: connectAddable is 41 lines and mixes levels: three refusal branches (already connected, key provider, host hook missing), a busy check, the notify closure, a try/catch around the host call, and the result post. The refusal branches repeat the same record + compose + reply + return "failed" shape (691-693, 697-701, 709-712).
findings.suggested_fix: Split a pure `connectRefusal(provider, host)` that returns the refusal text or undefined, and keep connectAddable as: refusal check, busy check, run login, post result.

findings.quote: // calling them unknown. Anything else falls back to the old message.
findings.problem: Stale comment. The diff changed its first line from `/models` / `/provider` are chat-mode commands to `/models` is a chat-mode command, but the continuation still says `calling them unknown`. It also now sits above a fallback that appends removedCommandHint, which the comment does not mention.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword: `/models` is a chat-mode command: say so instead of calling it unknown. A removed command gets its hint; anything else falls back to the old message.

findings.problem: pickProvidersTabbedStep is about 440 lines (3260-3700). One closure holds row layout (RowBlock, labelOf, mark text), highlight, key handling, tab switching, painting (paint is ~110 lines), capacity maths and the surface wiring.
findings.suggested_fix: Extract row building and painting into pure helpers taking the state they read (rows, selected, tab, width), and keep the step function as wiring. Not needed for this PR; do it when the next tab is added.

findings.problem: runProviderConnectSequence(otui, target, prov, deps, setup, requireKey = false) has six parameters, two of them booleans. The call at 3980 reads `runProviderConnectSequence(otui, target, action.provider, deps, true, true)`, and the pick call at 3970 ends `deps, false)`; the meaning of each bare boolean is invisible at the call site.
findings.suggested_fix: Take an options object `{ setup, requireKey }` (or a named mode such as `"add" | "first-run"` if the two always travel together).

findings.problem: The same dependency object is rebuilt by spreading modelDeps three times: in runProvidersModal (3945-3949), in runProviderConnectSequence (3851-3855) and in selectProviderModelInTui (~4085-4089). Each adds the same couple of fields to the shared base.
findings.suggested_fix: Build the extended deps once (a small `withConnectDeps(modelDeps)` helper) and pass it down.

findings.problem: The option `onlyConnected` (SelectProviderModelOptions, chat-shell.ts pickSelection type ~314-317 and use ~650-652, /connect handler 10444) now means "open the Providers modal", not "list only connected providers". `selectProviderModelInTui` returns `runProvidersModal(...)` early when it is set, and the modal opens on the Add provider tab when nothing is connected.
findings.suggested_fix: Rename to something like `providersModal` (or `mode: "providers"`) in all three places in one commit.
